_doc: Headline-theorem registry. research/tools/claims.py validates every name against OddPerfect/ sources and the import graph of OddPerfect.lean, then regenerates research/CLAIMS.md. Classes: REPLAY (formalizes a published result), CANDIDATE-NEW (no prior result found yet; literature-checker must confirm before the word 'new' is used anywhere), REDUCTION (conditional / bookkeeping implication), LIBRARY (true but does not change BRANCH_MAP or FLOOR_CEILING). 'branch' refers to BRANCH_MAP node ids.

claims.name: euler_form
claims.statement: Every odd perfect N is q^a m^2 with q prime, q ∤ m, q ≡ a ≡ 1 (mod 4).

claims.name: not_dvd_105_of_odd_perfect
claims.statement: 105 does not divide an odd perfect number.

claims.name: steuerwald
claims.statement: Not every non-Euler exponent equals 2.

claims.name: sigmaEdge_reachable
claims.statement: The divisor-sum graph on the prime support of a perfect number is strongly connected.

claims.name: dickson_finite
claims.statement: For fixed k, finitely many odd perfect N have ω(N) ≤ k (explicit bound).

claims.name: exists_componentIndex_cardFactors_add_six_le
claims.statement: Some component index i_p satisfies Ω(i_p) + 6 ≤ Ω(N).
claims.literature: none found; relative drop does not bound any parameter (NO_GO §1)

claims.name: not_existsOddPerfect_of_componentIndex_multiplicity_cap
claims.statement: A uniform cap Ω(i_p) ≤ K plus emptiness below a doubly-exponential bound implies no OPN.

claims.name: toth_odd_pair_four_iff
claims.statement: The unique odd 4-prime Tóth pair is (9018009, 22021).

claims.name: linear_euler_unique_q_source_and_bound
claims.statement: At a = 1, a unique prime r₀ | m has q ∥ σ(r₀^(2e₀)); also 2q < 3 r₀^(2e₀).

claims.name: universal_half_succ_index_gcd_square_parametrization
claims.statement: At a = 1: (q+1)/2 = g h₀², i_q = g u₀², m = g h₀ u₀.

claims.name: linear_euler_coprime_half_succ_quotient_system
claims.statement: On the coprime half-successor sub-branch: u² = W σ(h²) and σ(u²) = W(2h² − 1).

claims.name: sixth_power_free_euler_exponent_one
claims.statement: A sixth-power-free OPN has Euler exponent 1 (other exponents 2 or 4).

claims.name: sixthPowerFree_total_prime_factor_count
claims.statement: Sixth-power-free ⇒ Ω(N) ≥ 1179.

claims.name: sixth_power_free_oneModThreeLarge_ge_80
claims.statement: Sixth-power-free ⇒ |Q₁₃| ≥ 80 and 2ω ≤ 11|Q₁₃| + 11.

claims.name: two_le_largeSources_of_three_free
claims.statement: 3 ∤ N ⇒ at least two non-Euler primes r ≠ 3 have exponent ≥ 4.
claims.literature: overlaps Ochem–Zelinsky (arXiv 2607.19746); priority must be checked

claims.name: euler_index_not_square_of_exponent_gt_one
claims.statement: For a > 1 the Euler index σ(m²)/q^a is not a square.

claims.name: euler_index_ne_prime_mul_square_of_fermat_obstruction
claims.statement: ExceptionalFermatObstruction ⇒ for a > 1 the Euler index is not ℓ t².

claims.name: exceptional_index_size_gt_ten_pow_740
claims.statement: On I = ℓ t² with a > 1, N > 10^740.

claims.name: component_prime_power_index_euler_only_and_septuple_lift
claims.statement: A prime-power component index can occur only at the Euler prime.

claims.name: even_prime_power_component_size_gt_ten_pow_353234555955090756
claims.statement: i_q = p^(2u) forces ≥ 13 repunit bases, 2u ≥ 1.3·10^16 and N > 10^(3.5·10^17).

claims.name: even_prime_power_component_base_lt_six_pow
claims.statement: i_q = p^(2u) ⇒ p < 6^u (Pell–Padé).
claims.literature: unchecked; ceiling on p, not on u

claims.name: even_index_base_subexponential
claims.literature: unchecked; ceiling on p, not on u

claims.name: finite_odd_nearPerfect_of_bounded_prime_count
claims.statement: Finitely many odd near-perfect numbers with ω ≤ k.
